FBA 8 teams per conference for tournament

FBAJC - 3 non-conference games instead of 2
Teams may swap draft picks during trades instead of trading picks
Young-Star Game will be a 4 team tournament, each team is led by a former FBA player
D3 will be a new league starting in S67 taking place right before D2. There will be 4 teams for the inaugural season.
D2 International Tournament has been changed to double elimination beginning in S66
S66 will be the final physically played season
FBA Playoffs will be 7 games series for every round beginning in S67
The FBA Draft Lottery will be weighted as following: 1:24%, 2:24%, 3:20%, 4:13%, 5:9%, 6:6%, 7:3%, 8:1%

FBA D2 World Cup will start with play-in games to get the field down to 16. Then there will be 4 groups of 4 with the top 2 of each group advancing. Then there will be an 8 team tournament with a 7-game series for each round.
League Expansion announced for the S68 season(4): Toronto Wolves*, Vegas Volts*, Honolulu Rays*, Manhattan Magic*

Teams starting in D1 will be 5 players per team(from 4) starting in S67. This will delay the introduction of D3 until S68 as all D2 teams must be filled to 5 players as well before D3 is introduced. Salary Cap will change to $25 from $20.
Draft Picks can now be protected within a trade such as lottery protected or top 3 protected.
Players May be traded pre-draft with expiring contracts and are not obligated to re-sign with the team they are traded too, contracts may only be negotiated during the free agency period.
D3 addition delayed to S68.
Cal Tech Golden Knights will play in Charlotte beginning in S68 and will be the Charlotte Knights.
Draft will be weighted as following for the S68 Draft due to expansion…: T1:14%, T1:14%, T1:14%, T1:14%, 5:12%, 6:10%, 7:8%, 8:6%, 9:4%, 10:3%, 11:2%, 12:1%
All-Star Game will have 26 players(13 per team) with 3-11 per position.
Young-Star will have 20 players divided into 4 teams who will play in a tournament. Team captains will be former players. 2-7 per position.

For 5pt contest: round 1(10 players) dice role 3 times, add to get score. Five players move to round 2. Role dice 3 more times and add to total score. Top 3 move on. 3 more dice roles added up to decide final scores. Dunk contest same rules with 4 players to start and one being eliminated each round.
For an expansion draft, each team can protect up to 4 players whether they are currently on contract or not

FBAD2 will hold multiple divisions. Each division will play a round robin with a playoff to decide a champion. After each season a promotion tournament will begin with the bottom two and top two playing in a round robin tournament. Assignment draft will be unchanged. World Cup will remain unchanged. D3 officially cancelled in favor of new system.
If there is a tie then the odds between those two teams are averaged out to be equal.
All Star Game Expanded to 14 players per team(28 total) with 4-11 per position. ASG Game will be played in 4 quarters, each team gets 5 rolls per quarter.
Each All-FBA Team is…: G, F, C, G/F/C, G/F/C
Seeding Tiebreaker: Roll dice 6 times for each team involved in the tie then base the order on the results.

Starting S70, FBAJC will require 12 team conferences from 10 team conferences. Out of conference play will go from 6 to 3 games, eliminating the out-of-conference exhibition games, keeping the 8-team tournaments.

After a player’s rookie contract expires, they become a restricted free agent. If a team makes an offer for this player, their current team will have an opportunity to match that offer. This applies to rookies signed by a team they were not drafted by during their draft year or signed by the team they were drafted by.
The Memphis Blues are moving to the Western Conference and the Charlotte Knights are moving to the Eastern Conference.

ASG Rules: 4 quarters are made of 5 player rosters. Each player gets 1 role per quarter. ASG MVP is the ASG MVP, must be from the winning team. For YSG each player gets 2 rounds of 2 rolls. For the ASG draft, a starting lineup must be each team’s first 4 picks
S69 tiebreaker rule abolished as of S70.
Pick trade clarification: if a pick does not meet the protection conditions, it rolls to the next season, keeps rolling until conditions are met.
Free Agency: If a team cuts a player, that teams salary cap gets decreased by $1 for every season left on the players contract as that players buyout. Rule starts in S72 offseason.
FBAD2: Promotion/Demotion tournaments are being abolished in favor of automatic promotion or demotion at the end of a given season. Starting in S71.
In an ASG draft, each team must pick their starting lineup as their first 4 picks.
FBAJC All-Americans Teams will go from PG/SG/SF/PF/C format to G/F/C/ANY/ANY.
Two D2 teams are moving locations. D2(Toronto) is becoming D2(Ottawa) and D2(Maine) is becoming D2(Omaha)
D2 World Cup will now hold 64 countries with each round being a best of 3 series, currently there are 40 countries with names players so the other 24 will have to be generated
Trade deadline is the second rating adjustment break
Hall of Fame induction moving to 2-3 players per season
The NIT will be added to FBAJC Postseason as a tournament for the best 32 teams who missed March Madness
New recruiting classes must have 12-13 5* and 3-5 3*, rest are 4*
2 Expansion dates announced. 2 teams to be added in S75 and 2 more in S79. S75 Cities are Atlanta and Vancouver. S79 Cities are Philadelphia and Minneapolis.
Philly Phantoms
Atlanta Venom
Vancouver Vikings
Minnesota Foxes
Charlotte Knights are changing their name to Carolina Knights
2 new conferences will be added to FBAJC(Big Sky & Mountain West) along with 24 new schools
Players may now compete in the 5pt or dunk contest regardless of if they have previously won the contest

Addition of the Most Improved Player(MIP) award for FBA. Simply given to the player who saw the highest rating boost(advantage given to players whose boost occurred higher: ex: 80-86 is better than 72-79). Rookies are ineligible and second season players are highly discouraged unless it was crazy.
A player is only eligible for Hall of Fame starting the season that they are 32, if a player retires early that season is the season they are first considered

For a draft, if I team wishes to not use their pick, they can temporarily skip until all picks have gone through, once all teams have skipped or picked, the skipped slots will be filled with players by their draft board rankings as an honorary pick. Honorary picks will all be made after all actual picks.
If there is a tie then the odds between those two teams are averaged out to be equal.
-multiply odds by 4 on wheel app

Minnesota Foxes expansion has been cancelled. Los Angeles will instead get an expansion team: ‘Los Angeles Labradors’. This team will start in S75. The S75 expansion of the Vancouver Vikings will be delayed to S79 with the Philly Phantoms
Vancouver Vikings name changed to Vancouver Orcas and will be brought in to the league in S75 as originally planned, Los Angeles Labradors delayed to S79.

For the S75 expansion draft, teams will have their top 3 players protected whether or not they are guaranteed to be on contract. All S75 Draft Picks are protected. Same with players with restricted contracts.
Young-Star Tournament captains will be the most recent hall of fame class + other hall of famers.

A player’s contract can be extended optionally 1 year before its expiration. If it is extended, the player’s new salary goes into effect immediately. This does not apply for 2 year rookie contracts. A player can opt to wait for the next season to test the open market.
For D2, each team must now have one of each positions, for each player that does not make a roster, they will be placed in the free agents section of the D2 Rosters page.
D2(Vancouver) is moving to Edmonton

For D2, new promotion rules: Regular Season champion & Playoffs champion are the two teams who will be promoted. In cases where those are the same team, second place in the regular season will be promoted.
For the young-star tournament, the 4 team captains are the most recent hall of fame class + a former young-star tournament winning captain.
Planned FBA Expansion (Philly Phantoms & Los Angeles Labradors) has been delayed to S80.
Every season a protected pick gets pushed back, the protection shrinks by 1 pick.
The S74 skip/honorary pick rule is removed as of the S79 Draft. The draft runs in order and every team makes a selection.
